With the search you can find all features from the indices and all text labels on the plan (more than 600).

In designing the present edition of the "Nuova Topografia di Roma" (New Topography of Rome, 12 sheets at a scale of 1:2900) and indices of the "Nuova Pianta di Roma" (New Map of Rome, index to the plan and diminished maps) we have spent great care with the aim to be as close to the original as possible regarding the labeling and the structure of the directories.

The explanations of the signatures and line styles, hatches and selected abbreviations are reproduced in their original form (see "Legend"). You can access Nolli's original spelling of the indices, legend, and other signs at the bottom of the English version in Italian language.

Alarmi is a mobile alarm system for your pocket with which you can protect your iPhone and many other things from theft or unauthorized access.

# ON THE BEACH
Beach idyll with towel, umbrella and lots of sand: But who will keep an eye on your phone, your car keys or your wallet when you go swimming?

If your beach bag moves and your iPhone is not unlocked, the iPhone will generate a very loud and distinctive alarm sound. The alarm sound can only be turned off by unlocking your iPhone. You will also receive a notification on your Apple Watch or on a second iPhone.

Your beloved YoungTimer is 30 years old and doesn't have an immobilizer or alarm system? 

Maybe you still have an older iPhone in the drawer (Alarmi works with iOS14 or newer and iPhone 6s or newer). Your alarm starts when you leave the vehicle (with Apple Watch) or lock the iPhone. # IN THE MOTORHOME OR CARAVAN.
Renting a mobile home without intrusion protection? Or you have an older camper for which the purchase of a professional and expensive alarm system is not worth it?

Trakų istorijos muziejaus ekspozicija prasideda kairiajame sparne, vadinamosiose „Vytautinėse“ menėse, kuriose, manoma, apsistodavęs Didysis kunigaikštis su žmona. Modernėjantis Trakų istorijos muziejus kiekvienais metais skiria daug dėmesio interaktyvioms pramogoms, įvairaus pobūdžio edukacijoms, nuolat surengia įdomių parodų, renginių ar atnaujina ilgalaikes ekspozicijas. Mūsų tikslas – įdomus, gyvas, nuolat besikeičiantis muziejus.
